title: 一亿度的火，凭啥烧不穿炉子？
title_en: Why Doesn't 100 Million Degrees Melt the Furnace?

segments.en: A fire at one hundred million degrees

segments.zh: 就关在合肥的一个“炉子”里。
segments.en: is locked inside a 'furnace' in Hefei.
A hundred million degrees.
Six or seven times the core of the Sun.

segments.zh: 这几天，抖音博主钻进“人造太阳”拍视频，
segments.en: This week, Douyin creators filmed inside China's 'artificial sun',
topping the science trending list.
At Bilibili's science night,
the artificial sun was a star too.
It's called EAST.
In January 2025 it held its plasma for over a thousand seconds.
One thousand sixty-six seconds,
almost eighteen minutes.
Today's brain teaser:

segments.zh: 一亿度，什么墙不化？凭啥烧不穿炉子？
segments.en: at a hundred million degrees, every wall melts. Why doesn't the furnace burn through?
Meet our hero:
a tiny hundred-million-degree fireball, Yiyi.

segments.zh: 这么热，原子都被扯散了，
segments.en: At that heat, atoms get torn apart:

segments.zh: 电子和原子核各跑各的。
segments.en: electrons and nuclei run separately.
This charged soup
is called plasma.
Twist one:
the wall never touches the fire.
Charged particles in a magnetic field

segments.zh: 就只能绕着磁力线打转。
segments.en: can only spiral around the field lines.

segments.zh: 磁力线就像过山车的轨道，
segments.en: Field lines are like roller-coaster tracks.

segments.zh: 车只能顺着轨道跑，跳不出去。
segments.en: The cars follow the track and can't jump off.

segments.zh: 把轨道首尾接成一个圈，
segments.en: Join the track into a loop

segments.zh: 就是个甜甜圈形的磁笼子。
segments.en: and you get a doughnut-shaped magnetic cage.
This cage
is called a tokamak.
The fireball floats in the middle,
far from the wall.

segments.zh: 太阳靠自己巨大的引力压住火，
segments.en: The Sun holds its fire with huge gravity.
We only have magnets.

segments.zh: 也正因为没有太阳那么大的压力，
segments.en: And without the Sun's crushing pressure,

segments.zh: 温度只好比太阳高得多。
segments.en: we have to go much hotter than the Sun.
Twist two:
a hundred million degrees isn't much heat.
Temperature is how fast particles move.

segments.zh: 热量还要看粒子有多少。
segments.en: Heat also depends on how many there are.

segments.zh: 估算一下：炉子里的等离子体，
segments.en: A rough estimate: the plasma is
a few hundred thousand times thinner than air.
Like a sparkler:

segments.zh: 火花上千度，落在手上却不烫。
segments.en: sparks over a thousand degrees, yet they don't burn your hand.
The sparks are too small and too few.

segments.zh: 热量还没传过来就没了。
segments.en: Their heat is gone before it reaches you.
So if the cage ever fails,

segments.zh: 火球一碰墙，自己先凉了。
segments.en: the fireball hits the wall and cools itself first.

segments.zh: 人造太阳不会像炸弹那样炸，
segments.en: An artificial sun can't explode like a bomb.
It just goes out.
The wall does get hurt a little,

segments.zh: 所以墙要用耐高温的钨来做。
segments.en: so it's armored with tough tungsten.
Twist three, the weirdest:

segments.zh: 最热的旁边，就是最冷的。
segments.en: right next to the hottest thing is the coldest.
The cage uses superconducting coils

segments.zh: 要冷到零下二百六十九度。
segments.en: chilled to minus two hundred sixty-nine degrees.

segments.zh: 一边一亿度，一边接近绝对零度，
segments.en: A hundred million degrees on one side, almost absolute zero on the other,

segments.zh: 中间就隔一层真空和几层墙。
segments.en: with just a vacuum and a few layers between.
It's like a thermos:

segments.zh: 中间抽成真空，热就传不过去。
segments.en: the vacuum in between stops the heat.
Why go to all this trouble?
The fuel is in seawater.

segments.zh: B站晚会上说：一瓶海水里的聚变能，
segments.en: At Bilibili's science night they said: the fusion energy in one bottle of seawater
could drive a car a thousand kilometers.

segments.zh: 友情提示：现在还发不出能卖的电，
segments.en: Fine print: it can't sell electricity yet.
Our guess: that's still many years away.

segments.zh: 比稀薄几十万倍，是我们的估算；
segments.en: Thinner by hundreds of thousands is our estimate.

segments.zh: 一千公里，是晚会上的说法。
segments.en: The thousand kilometers is what the show said.

segments.zh: 所以，一亿度凭啥烧不穿炉子？
segments.en: So why doesn't a hundred million degrees burn through?

segments.zh: 因为火碰不到墙，而且它太稀了。
segments.en: The fire never touches the wall, and it's very thin.
The secret of the artificial sun

segments.zh: 不是更结实的炉子，是一个看不见的笼子。
segments.en: is not a stronger furnace, but an invisible cage.

elements.text: 一千公里：晚会上的说法
